Thursday Big Book meeting
This is an open, literature-based discussion meeting for all who may be interested in our way of life. Discussions may also involve sharing about the Twelve Traditions and Twelve Concepts. (The Big Book is AA's fond nickname for our basic text Alcoholics Anonymous) Big Books (in English and Spanish) are available at the meeting.
